feedback.answered: Controller assessment confirms the scoped read-prefix identity violation after correspondence review. Ordinary applied-index publication was then traced: setApplied only advances internal index/term; setLastApplied publishes the visible index after handleEntry returns, so ApplyConfigChange precedes visibility. Snapshot recovery differs: apply writes lastApplied before Recover calls RestoreRemotes; the latter competes for raftMu with the initialized node step worker. This leaves a distinct sourced authority-transition question, without assuming that the available locks fail in a legal history.
